COMPOSITE FENCING, RESIN PATIO & PATH – WARBOYS
🔧 Before: Tired Fencing and No Usable Outdoor Space

The garden was let down by worn, outdated timber fencing that had lost its structure and any visual appeal it once had. The outdoor space felt neglected and disconnected, with no clean surfaces and nothing pulling the property together. The homeowner wanted a full overhaul — proper privacy, a low-maintenance patio, and a path that actually worked for everyday use. 




Key issues:




Rotting and mismatched timber fencing offering little privacy or kerb appeal
No usable patio surface — loose gravel with no defined layout
Dated overall appearance with no cohesion between spaces
High maintenance requirements with poor long-term durability

🧱 Our Vision

A complete transformation from the boundary outward. New composite fencing was installed throughout to give the property strong, clean lines and full privacy — built to last decades without rotting, warping or needing repainting. Dove Grey resin bound surfacing was then laid across both the patio and path areas using Resin Mill products, delivering a smooth, seamless finish that ties the whole space together. 




 Planned works included: 

Full removal of old fencing and preparation of posts and boundary line
Installation of dark grey composite fencing panels with black aluminium posts throughout
Full base preparation and laying of Dove Grey resin bound patio
Resin bound path installed with matching Dove Grey finish and block edging for a sharp border
Full site cleanup on completion

THE RESULTS
Dove Grey UV Resin Mix (Resin Mill)
Why Dove Grey Was Chosen for This Project:

Light, Sophisticated Palette: Dove Grey is a premium marble blend sourced from the quarries of Spain, featuring a harmonious mix of light greys and pristine whites. Against the dark composite fencing panels, the contrast is sharp and intentional — the light surface and dark boundary work together to give the space a modern, high-end feel.
 
 UV Stability: Fully UV-stable, meaning those soft grey and white tones stay consistent and true over time — no yellowing, no uneven fading, even in direct sun across a fully exposed patio and path. 

 

Timeless and Versatile: Dove Grey's clean, neutral palette works with virtually any architectural style — which made it the right call for this Warboys property where the priority was a finish that would look just as good in ten years as it does today

Before: Worn Out Slabs Going Nowhere

The homeowner wanted to completely transform the space into something clean, modern and low maintenance that they could actually use and enjoy.  

 

Key issues:

Cracked and uneven slab surface throughout
Heavy staining and discolouration with no visual appeal
Poorly maintained joints allowing weed growth
Outdated appearance with no cohesion to the rest of the property

🛠 Our Vision

The goal was simple — strip it back completely and replace it with a surface the customer would be proud of for years to come. A full removal of the existing slabs was carried out before the base was properly prepped and levelled for the new installation.

 

Full removal of old slabs and thorough base preparation
Installation of a permeable sub-base ensuring long-term drainage compliance
Hand-laid Verona resin bound surfacing throughout using Resin Mill products

UV-stable and slip-resistant materials ensuring a safe, long-lasting result
Full site cleanup on completion leaving the space ready to enjoy immediately

Verona UV Resin Mix (Resin Mill)

Sophisticated Grey Blend: Verona is a stunning mix of mid and dark greys with subtle cool tones — delivering a sleek, contemporary finish that sits perfectly against the charcoal block edging and brick exterior of the property. UV Stability: Verona's fully UV-stable composition means the tones stay sharp, consistent and true to colour over time — no yellowing, no fading, even through long periods of direct sunlight on the patio.

RESIN UPGRADE – SAWTRY
Before: Tired Front Garden with Mixed Surfaces – Sawtry

Before the upgrade, this Sawtry front garden featured a combination of loose decorative stone, uneven planting areas, and ageing pathways that required frequent upkeep. While the layout had character, the multiple surface types and worn edging made the space feel disjointed and harder to maintain. Loose gravel regularly shifted out of place, weeds were difficult to control, and the overall appearance lacked the clean, structured finish expected from a modern front garden.  




Key issues:




Mixed surfaces creating an inconsistent, cluttered appearance
Loose stone areas prone to movement and weed growth
Uneven edges requiring frequent maintenance
Dated finish that didn’t reflect the home’s full potential

🌿 Our Vision

Our vision for this project in Sawtry was to transform a fragmented, high-maintenance front garden into a clean, cohesive resin-bound driveway and garden space that enhanced both practicality and kerb appeal. The existing layout featured mixed materials and uneven surfaces, so the aim was to introduce a smooth, modern finish while retaining the character of the central planting feature. 




Planned works included:

 

Removing loose stone areas and tired surface materials
Preparing and levelling the ground for a solid, long-lasting base
Installing a UV-stable resin-bound surface with clean, defined edging
Creating a unified layout that improved access, drainage, and overall kerb appeal

THE RESULTS
Transcendence Resin Mix (Resin Mill)
Why This Mix Was Chosen for This Project

Rich, Natural Colour Blend: The Sorrento mix features warm red and golden aggregate creating a warm tone, welcoming finish that complements brickwork, timber fencing, and surrounding landscaping.
 
UV-Stable & Fade Resistant: Specially formulated using UV-stable resin, this blend retains its colour vibrancy over time, even in direct sunlight—ideal for open pathways and exposed side access areas.
 
Permeable & SUDS-Compliant: The porous surface promotes natural water drainage, helping prevent puddles and surface runoff. It meets Sustainable Urban Drainage System (SUDS) regulations—making it an eco-conscious choice.
 
Smooth Yet Slip-Resistant: The compact, seamless finish delivers a clean, contemporary look that’s easy to walk on and maintain—perfect for Pathway.

🛠️ Before: Front Garden Cleanup & Access Rework

This property featured a poorly maintained front garden with crumbling concrete steps, mismatched turf remnants, and uneven surfacing. The layout posed clear safety risks and lacked curb appeal. Before renovation, the space was difficult to navigate, collect debris and weeds, and offered no practical use or visual consistency. 




Key issues:




Broken and sloped concrete steps
Torn artificial turf and loose gravel
Exposed edging and drainage problems
No safe or defined walking route
Visually messy and hard to maintain

🧱 Our Vision

To restore functionality and visual appeal, the goal was to install a durable, low-maintenance resin-bound pathway system that tied together the front and side access areas with a cohesive design. A warm, natural-toned blend was selected to complement the property’s brick exterior while offering practical year-round benefits like slip resistance and SUDS-compliant drainage. 




 Planned works included: 




Full ground clearance and debris removal
Proper sub-base installation across all zones
Level correction for step integration
UV-stable resin-bound surfacing
Seamless finish connecting lawn, side path, and entrance threshold

THE RESULTS
🧱 Full Resin Driveway & Front Entrance Transformation

 What was once a messy, uneven front garden with broken steps, torn turf, and exposed soil is now a fully finished resin-bound driveway and front entrance. The original area was difficult to maintain, visually disjointed, and offered no practical use as a driveway or entry point. 

Full removal of the old surface and ground preparation




 We completely cleared the space and rebuilt it from the ground up — removing the old surfaces and installing a new, stable base to support a durable, low-maintenance resin finish. Using the Evening Rose aggregate blend, we delivered a clean, polished look that ties in with the brickwork and adds real curb appeal.
 

 Work completed: 

 

Full removal of turf, gravel, concrete, and old steps
 

Excavation and installation of a solid permeable sub-base
 

Resin-bound finish across the new driveway and front entry steps
 

UV-stable, slip-resistant surface that stays clean and weed-free
 

Built for daily use, vehicle weight, and long-term durability

🌿Aspen Resin-Bound (Resin Mil)
Why This Resin Mil Mix Was Chosen for This Project

Cool, Contemporary Colour Palette: Aspen features a clean combination of soft greys, whites, and charcoal tones. It’s a modern, minimalist blend that pairs beautifully with red brick, slate, or timber — perfect for contemporary properties. 

 

UV-Stable & Fade Resistant: Manufactured using high-quality UV-stable resin, Aspen maintains its colour integrity even under constant sunlight exposure. It’s ideal for driveways, entrances, and exposed open spaces.
 
Permeable & SUDS-Compliant: Like all Resin Mill blends, Aspen allows water to drain naturally through the surface. It helps eliminate standing water, reduces runoff, and meets Sustainable Urban Drainage System (SUDS) requirements.
 
Smooth & Slip-Resistant: The tightly compacted stones deliver a seamless, non-slip surface that’s safe to walk and drive on — even in wet conditions. It’s a great all-rounder for everyday use.

Sunk in several areas, leading to pooling water and safety hazards
Weeds and moss taking root between cracks 
A deteriorating garden wall and lack of privacy at the front boundary
A dated look that clashed with the home's clean modern exterior

Full excavation and removal of existing block paving
Installation of a new sub-base with proper drainage layers to prevent water pooling
Resin-bound driveway installation using a Aspen resin mix for a clean, contemporary finish
Charcoal block edging added for visual definition and surface integrity
Bespoke slatted timber fencing fitted along the front boundary for both curb appeal and added privacy
Flush step installation at the entrance for improved access and safety




THE RESULTS
✅ Driveway & Boundary Transformation

 A sleek, seamless resin driveway with a bright, modern finish
 

Custom timber slatted fencing that adds style, privacy and boundary definition
 

Instant uplift in kerb appeal, with the fence and drive complementing each other perfectly
 

Zero standing water after rain, thanks to resin permeability and correct sub-base
 

A low-maintenance, weed-resistant surface designed to last for years
 

The entire frontage now reflects a cohesive, clean, and contemporary aesthetic

🌟 Aspen UV-Stable Resin Mix (Resin Mill)
Why Aspen Was Chosen for This Project

Modern Curb Appeal: Aspen’s pale tone dramatically lifted the frontage, replacing the dull, dark block paving with a fresh, contemporary resin driveway that matched the home’s rendered exterior and white-framed windows. 
UV Stability: Being fully UV-stable, the mix will not yellow or fade over time, ensuring the surface keeps its brightness even in full sun — ideal for exposed front driveways. 
Pairs Beautifully with Features: The pale stone blend contrasts beautifully with charcoal block edging and natural timber fencing, making it an excellent choice for coordinated outdoor design. 

PERFECTLY LAID, STRAIGHT AND VERY PROFESSIONALLY DONE.
